# Warrior One Pose - Let's Refine Your Form! 🧘

---

Hey, great effort stepping into Warrior One! I can see you're really committed, and you've got a solid foundation going. I just want to walk you through a few adjustments that are going to make this pose feel so much more powerful and aligned for you.

## Let's Straighten That Spine

First, I'm noticing that **your spine is rounding a little bit**. Think about lengthening through your entire back — imagine there's a string gently pulling you up from the crown of your head toward the ceiling. Roll your shoulders back and down, engage your core slightly, and feel that beautiful tall, straight line from your tailbone all the way up. That's going to make a world of difference in how this pose feels.

## Reach Those Arms Up

Next, let's talk about **your arms**. I want to see them reaching **straight up toward the sky**, fully extended, with your biceps close to your ears. Right now they're drifting a bit. Think about energy flowing from your shoulders all the way through your fingertips. Reach up with confidence!

## Align That Front Knee

Lastly, take a look at **your front knee** — it's drifting a little and isn't stacking **directly over your ankle**. This is really important for protecting your joint. Adjust your stance so that your shin is perpendicular to the floor. You may need to widen or shorten your stance slightly.

---

You're doing **wonderful** work. Small adjustments lead to big transformations. Let's try it again! 💪
